overloadPatches.semanticRole: Sets aTable as the default table for the current process, so that subsequent commands omitting their table parameter operate on it instead.

constraints: DEFAULT TABLE does not allow omission of the table name when referring to fields directly (e.g. 'My Field:=...' still requires '[My Table]My Field:=...'); it only affects commands that accept an optional table parameter.
DEFAULT TABLE does not open a table, set a current record/selection, or prepare the table for input/output -- it is purely a convenience for omitting table parameters elsewhere.
Takes priority over an identically named default table form when a project form is used with commands such as DIALOG.
